    green_centers.append((center_row, center_col))

# Convert all green platforms

print(f"\nConverting {len(actions)} green platforms...")

# Do them one at a time to check for level completion

    result = action([act])
    print(f"  {i+1}: level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}, done={last_action_result.get('done')}")
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'):
